hero.lede: Grading, excavation, asphalt and concrete paving, hauling, roll-off dumpsters and portable restrooms for homes, businesses and job sites across the CSRA. From driveways to developments, done right and on schedule.

sections.title: From site prep *to finished surface*
sections.intro: We mobilize the equipment, tools and operators for residential, maintenance and site-construction work, meeting insurance and safety requirements. We handle many large jobs, but no job is too small.

items.title: Grading & excavation
items.text: Land clearing, lot leveling, trenching, drainage and slope, erosion control: foundation-ready and paving-ready.

items.title: Asphalt paving
items.text: Driveways, parking lots, private roads, resurfacing, patching, seal-coating and line striping.

items.title: Concrete
items.text: Sidewalks, slabs, pads, curbs and gutters, patios and driveways, with clean finishing and good drainage.

items.title: Dump truck & hauling
items.text: Dirt, gravel, sand, asphalt and debris, delivered or removed on schedule.

items.title: Roll-off dumpsters
items.text: 10, 20 and 30 yard containers for construction waste, cleanouts, roofing and storm debris.

items.title: Portable restrooms
items.text: Clean, serviced units for job sites and events, keeping crews close and OSHA-compliant.

sections.title: From a small contractor *to a full-service firm*

image.alt: The B&K Grading and Paving office, a metal building with the BK logo

body: Jason Brittain founded B&K Grading and Paving in 2009 as a small contracting company specializing in general site work and waste disposal. Through acquisitions it grew into a fully integrated contracting firm with three locations and hundreds of employees.

We’re known for clear communication, safe operations, efficient scheduling and workmanship that holds up, on residential, commercial and industrial projects in Aiken, Augusta, North Augusta and across the CSRA.

items.a: Yes. We handle many large jobs, but no job is too small, from a single driveway to a full development.

items.q: What size dumpsters do you rent?
items.a: 10, 20 and 30 yard roll-off dumpsters, delivered and picked up on schedule.

items.q: Can you prepare the site and pave it?
items.a: Yes. We grade and prepare the base, then pave in asphalt or concrete, so one contractor handles it start to finish.
Yes. We have offices in Aiken, SC and Augusta, GA and work across the CSRA. Call (706) 251-8608 for Augusta.
We’re always looking for Class A and B CDL drivers, paving crew foremen and skilled construction workers. Email your resume to contact@bkgradingandpaving.com.

sections.text: Tell us about your project and we’ll confirm availability.
